messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Autopager fired for service="inference-gateway" region=eu-west-1. Metric=error_rate. Window=2m. Value=6.8%. Pager -> oncall@pagerduty (Ryan). Incident ID PAG-4462001234
Ryan (oncall): ack — I'm on it
Alex: taking lead on mitigation, moving to the thread
Jia: grabbing metrics + logs now. Are we seeing 502/504 or 5xx mix?
Alex: mostly 502 + some 504s, tail latency increased too. Possible backend read timeouts.
Maria: support shows 3 customer complaints in last 10m, tickets created. No PII reported.
Alex: quick triage — did anything deploy to eu-west around this time?
Jia: there was a canary rollout finishing ~4461998000. Pulling rollout logs.
Pagerduty: Unacknowledged for 2m -> escalating to eng-sre rotation
IncidentBot: automated escalation to Eng-SRE notified
Alex: running recommended runbook steps: scaling proxy pool and enabling fallback routing. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/5xx-autopage
Alex: scaling ingress-proxy replicas in eu-west:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment ingress-proxy --replicas=12
```
Alex: enabling traffic fallback to model-small in eu-west:
```
curl -s -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/fallback -d '{"route":"model-small","region":"eu-west-1"}'
```
Jia: KV cache miss rate spiked at the same time — looks like cache was evicted during rollout. Warmup scripts running now.
Alex: posting diagnostic snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:34:12Z] ingress-proxy eu-west1 502 backend read timeout backend-12
[2026-03-15T02:34:13Z] inference-runtime eu-west1 kvcache miss id=0x7a4
[2026-03-15T02:34:14Z] ingress-proxy eu-west1 504 upstream write timeout
```
Maria: I notified support to message impacted customers if this persists >30m. Draft ready, waiting on final impact numbers.
Comms: acknowledged, standing by for customer-facing language
Alex: metrics update — error rate falling: 6.8% -> 3.1% in 4m after scaling, now 1.6% last minute.
Jia: cache warmup completed, kvhit rate back to baseline. Backend latency normalized.
Ryan (oncall): nice work. Keep monitoring for 15m stable window. If <1% for 15m we can close the pager.
Alex: adding temporary mitigations to post-incident notes: pin rollout, add warmup step, adjust autopage thresholds for rapid deploys.
Jia: opening RCA ticket: INF-5521. Will investigate why cache eviction coincided with canary finalization.
Maria: current customer impact summary: 3 customers affected, intermittent errors, no data loss.
IncidentBot: Pager auto-close scheduled if no regressions in 30m.
Ryan (oncall): handing off monitoring to morning shift @Alex @Jia. Leaving note in oncall doc. :thumbsup:
Alex: leaving logs and commands used in the thread for followup.
Jia: will follow up with a short postmortem and recommended runbook changes.
Ryan (oncall): closing our active actions here — reopen if we see another spike. Thanks all.
